description: A guided, data-grounded SEO audit workflow for the SEOmatic connector: real Search Console, keyword, backlink and AI-visibility data turned into a prioritized action plan the user can approve.

defaultPrompt: Run a full SEO audit of my site and rank the fixes by impact.
Which keywords is my site close to ranking on page 1 for?
Why did my traffic drop, and what should I fix first?
interface.longDescription: Ask for an SEO audit and get a methodical, data-grounded review of your own website through the SEOmatic connector: top queries and pages, keywords one push from page 1, title/meta mismatches losing clicks, traffic decay and who took it, indexation health, backlink velocity, and AI-answer visibility. The report leads with a verdict and ranks actions by expected impact, each justified by a number from your data. On paid SEOmatic plans the fixes can be staged as tasks that always wait for your approval. Requires the SEOmatic MCP connector (https://app.seomatic.ai/api/mcp).
interface.shortDescription: SEO audit from your real data

name: seomatic-seo-audit
